newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq inches higher at Tuesday close.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq inches higher at Tuesday close.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks closed higher Tuesday but failed to repeat Monday's rally, their fervor stilled by a weak bond market.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 0.72, or 0.06 percent, at 1149.43, its unofficial close with decliners leading advancing issues 2125 to 1952 on volume of about 486 million shares.

Iomega Corp traded higher after announcing this morning an non-exclusive licensing agreement with Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd. Iomega shares were up 2-2/16 at 15-7/16 in active trading.
Dell Computer Corp was up 2-1/8 at 71. CS First Boston said it initiated coverage of Dell with a buy.

Anchor Gaming rallied 5-1/2 to 58-1/4. Anchor and International Game Technology said on Tuesday they had signed a memorandum of understanding to form a strategic alliance. IGT shares were were up 1/2 at 20-7/8 on the NYSE.
Ascend Communications Inc shares were up 5/8 at 55-5/8. SoundView Financial group said it initiated coverage of the stock with a short-term and long-term hold.
